Because the echo burn is logged at the marble settlement, the glacier audit shows the destroyed amount and the recipient of the rest. 92% of every slash is burned and the remainder goes to the wronged party, so no one can profit from a farm's failure except the party it harmed. A 352 account operation therefore ties up 3 million dollars of idle capital. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
